notes: BW25113 and elaA/cysW knockouts, all carrying pMAL-p2x with L-asparaginase; sampled before (0h) and 6h after 1 mM IPTG. Control = BW25113 0h (uninduced). Induction at OD 0.8-1.5 in TB (above inferable range) so no growth phase. Library used magnetic-bead mRNA purification; rrna_removal left out (method not specified). Plasmid-borne asparaginase not counted as genotype change (all strains carry it). Double KO set as deletion with two genes.
